<a id="symbol-PostgresError"></a>
## `PostgresError` · class · [source](contracts.aug#L5)

Client failures use negative codes. Server failures preserve SQLSTATE through sqlState. Messages omit connection strings, parameters and server text. It implements `Error`.

It takes `code` as an integer, kept read-only and `message` as a string, kept read-only.

<a id="symbol-DatabaseStorage"></a>
## `DatabaseStorage` · capability interface · [source](contracts.aug#L8)

Permission to configure an explicitly bounded PostgreSQL pool. Construct this service inside the worker that will own the pool.

<a id="symbol-DatabaseStorage.open"></a>
### `DatabaseStorage.open` · [source](contracts.aug#L9)

It takes `configuration` as a string and `maximum`, `connectMilliseconds`, and `cleanupMilliseconds` as integers. It returns ownership of [`Pool`](bindings.aug.md#symbol-Pool). It can call [`DatabaseStorage.open`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-DatabaseStorage.open). Failures can raise [`PostgresError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-PostgresError).

## Dependencies

It uses [`Pool`](bindings.aug.md#symbol-Pool) from `bindings`.
